messages:
Ana M: Quick sync — I'm assembling the deploy manifest for today's release train (10:30 PT). Need owners for three lanes (api, runtime, console) and a quick rollback readiness check.
Jordan P: I can take runtime lane. runtime v2.1 on canary nodes. rollback plan: snapshot + runbook updated. @Liam K can you confirm infra toggles?
Liam K: Confirmed — infra runbook updated, db migration is reversible and flagged. Need ~10m to finalize feature-flag toggles.
Sophia R: I'll pick up console. CI green, smoke tests passing locally. Want canary config: 5% traffic, routing policy = latency-first.
Maya S: I'll own API lane. I'll run the traffic shift and the /healthz probes. Rollback plan: revert to tag 2026-03-16-rc if anything spikes.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled at 10:40 PT. Will post heartbeat every 5m. Current queue order: api → runtime → console.
Jordan P: Runtime needs a GPU drain prestep (evict long-running jobs). @Ana M can you add that to the manifest? Also set expected error baselines for the canary.
Ana M: Added GPU drain and baselines, pushed manifest snippet: ```yaml
lanes:
  - name: api
    owner: Maya S
    rollback_tag: "2026-03-16-rc"
  - name: runtime
    owner: Jordan P
    presteps:
      - gpu_drain: true
    expected_5m_error_rate: 0.5%
  - name: console
    owner: Sophia R
    canary_pct: 5
    routing: latency-first
```
Liam K: Looks good. Who's handling post-deploy alerting? @Sophia R can you cover 10:30–11:30, and @Maya S take 11:30–12:30?
Sophia R: I can do 10:30–11:30. Will watch SLO dashboards and error spikes.
Maya S: I can take 11:30–12:30, will monitor logs and paging.
Ana M: Final checklist — owners assigned (Maya/API, Jordan/runtime, Sophia/console), rollback tags set, GPU drain added, on-call windows covered. If no objections we'll kick the queue at 10:30 PT.
Jordan P: :thumbsup: proceeding.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Starting deploy queue in 5m — posting step updates in this thread.
